shared-database:billing-db.title: Billing uses Order service's database
shared-database:billing-db.message: orders-db sits in Orders team with Order service, which uses it. Billing, outside Orders team, goes to it directly: a change to its tables now has to ship in both.
shared-database:billing-db.rationale: Database per service: each service's data stays private to it and is reached only through its API. A second service using the same tables couples their deploys and schemas, so neither can change them alone.

entry-gateway:orders.title: Mobile app calls Order service directly
entry-gateway:orders.message: Traffic from outside comes in through Commerce gateway, but Mobile app reaches Order service around it: nothing in front of Order service filters attacks or limits the rate.
entry-gateway:orders.rationale: Traffic from the internet should pass a gateway or web application firewall before it reaches a service: it terminates TLS, filters attacks, checks who's calling and limits the rate, in one place.
